settings.heading: Love it or your money back
settings.body: Try it at home for 30 days. If your pet isn't loving it, just contact us and we'll make it right with a full refund. Every order ships free with tracking, so you always know where it is.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. Delivery typically takes 7–15 business days. Shipping is always free and every order includes a tracking number.

settings.question: How does the 20% bundle discount work?
settings.answer: Add both the Smart Automatic Pet Feeder and the Smart Laser Cat Toy to your cart and 20% is taken off automatically at checkout — no code needed.

settings.question: What if my pet doesn't like it?
settings.answer: You're covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. Contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll help you with a return and full refund.

settings.question: Do I need Wi-Fi for the feeder?
settings.answer: Only for the Wi-Fi models, which you control from your phone. The Classic Button model works on its own with simple one-touch scheduling.

settings.question: Is the laser safe for my cat?
settings.answer: Yes, when used as intended. Never point the laser directly at eyes, and finish each session with a toy your cat can catch to keep playtime satisfying.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Payments are processed through Shopify's encrypted checkout. We never see or store your card details.
